description: Migration class for creating and modifying workshop-related database tables and fields, including schema definitions and SQL migration scripts.

classes.name: GoteoWorkshopLanding
classes.description: Class handling database migrations for workshop features, including creating tables, adding columns, and defining foreign keys.

methods.name: preUp
methods.description: Checks if 'workshop' table exists; if not, creates 'workshop' and 'workshop_lang' tables.

methods.name: getUpSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to alter existing tables and create new tables related to workshops.

methods.name: getDownSQL
methods.description: Returns SQL statements to revert the schema changes made in getUpSQL.
